basis: Best quality/success class on all 140 selection cases, counting unique type/dimension/fixture as well; preferred simpler rtol and intermediate inner tolerance.

final_decision.reason: Quality/success class ties with inner1e-4 and2e-3; no case meets material timing-difference criterion between inner candidates. Retain intermediate1e-3. Accept documented new-dimension and worst-error regressions under balanced selection policy.
limits: 140 former search/holdout cases were reused for selection.
48 new-dimension cases use related fixture families.
No claim of uniformly improved accuracy, runtime, or worst-case residual.
Default custom math/TMP only for selection; strict std-math regressions are separate.
